title: ADHD vs Non-ADHD Texting Back 😂 #adhd #shorts
desc:
Read it. Answer it in my head. Three weeks later... 😂 Who are YOU leaving on read right now? 👇

Tip: if it takes under two minutes, answer it right now. Even just "saw this, will reply tonight."

#adhd #adhdlife #adhdbrain #adhdproblems #adhdhumor #shorts #relatable #funny

beats.say: Here's how a normal person texts back. Phone buzzes. Read it. Reply. Done.
beats.label: NON-ADHD:

beats.say: Now here's me. My best friend texts me. Hey, you good?
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: I read it. I answer it. In my head. Perfect answer. Funny too.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: I'll reply when I can give it my full attention. That's respect.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Wait. Did I ever text her back? I can see the reply. I remember sending it.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Now it's been too long. I can't just say yeah I'm good. I need a whole explanation.
beats.label: ADHD:
beats.cap: Now it needs a whole speech.

beats.say: So I'll wait until I have time to write the speech.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: She calls me. I panic. I let it ring. Then I text her. Sorry, can't talk right now.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: I was not busy. I was on the couch. Holding the phone.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Here's why. An answer you planned feels done to your brain, even when you never sent it. So if a reply takes under two minutes, send it right now. Even just, saw this, I'll call you tonight. Short beats perfect.
beats.cap2: Tip: under 2 minutes? Reply now. Short beats perfect.

beats.say: Who are you leaving on read right now? Go text them. Then tell me in the comments.
